title: Find First Set Bit
description: Find the position of the first set bit (1) from the right side in binary representation.

data.text: Given a positive integer `N`, find the position of the first set bit (1) from the right side in its binary representation. Positions are 1-indexed.
Shift right until finding a 1, counting the position. O(log N) time.

data.title: Right Shift O(log N)
data.content: Shift right until finding a 1, counting the position.

data.text: Use `n & (n-1)` to isolate the rightmost set bit, then take log2. O(1) time.

data.title: n & (n-1) Trick O(1)
data.content: Isolate the rightmost set bit, then take log2.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: The `n & (n-1)` trick isolates the rightmost set bit in one operation. Combined with `Math.Log`, it gives O(1) time instead of O(log N).
